name: socratic-codex
description: Adaptive, foundation-first learning workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Adaptive teaching with diagnosis, dependency maps, and mixed-format checks.
interface.longDescription: Turn a Codex task into a guided learning session. Socratic Codex diagnoses prior knowledge, builds a small dependency path, teaches from stable foundations, checks understanding with varied question formats and externally randomized answer positions, uses native research and visualization capabilities, and can keep an opt-in Markdown learning log through Codex hooks.
defaultPrompt: Use $learn to teach me a topic from first principles.
Use $learn to diagnose what I know about neural networks.
Use $learn for a deep guided lesson and save Markdown notes.
